paymentMethods: We accept bank transfer, eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay QR and cash.

faq.q: Can we mix events that aren't in a package?
faq.a: Yes. Pick any events from the single-event list. Three or more events get a bundle discount close to the nearest package.

faq.q: What if our ceremony runs late?
faq.a: We never leave mid-ritual. Overtime is NPR 4,000 per hour, agreed on the day with the family.

faq.q: Do you cover Newari, Brahmin, Chhetri, Madhesi and Tamang weddings?
faq.a: Yes. We go through the rituals with you before the day, so we're in the right place at the right moment.

faq.q: How many photos will we get?
faq.a: Usually 600–1,200 edited photos per wedding day, and 250+ in the printed album.
